_comment: Python PRIMARY scripts that CANNOT carry a non-cp1252 character through a
pipe when imported -- their streams are left at the host default, so a report
carrying one dies (stdout) or is mangled (stderr). This list is DEBT, not a
pass: green means no NEW one landed. It may only get SHORTER.
Add the five-line reconfiguration block at IMPORT (both streams) and delete
the entry in the SAME commit; the guard refuses an entry that now passes.
Adding a file here instead of fixing it is exactly what the ratchet refuses.
✔MEASURED 2026-08-23 (cycle P29, lane L): four reached the property late or
not at all -- check-retyped-closed-sets and check-shell-portability
reconfigured inside main(), refresh_landing_log and sqlite-runtime-bench never.
Their --help and bad-flag paths were probed through a cp1252 pipe and none
died TODAY, so these are LATENT rather than live. Latent is what
check-anchor-balance was until the day its --help printed zero bytes.
✔2026-08-24 (cycle P29, independent step-10 audit): check-retyped-closed-sets
was REPAIRED -- the block moved to import -- and its entry deleted in the same
commit, because the guard refuses a repaired entry that lingers. That refusal
is what made the deletion happen rather than being remembered.
✔2026-09-18 (lane mig): refresh_landing_log REPAIRED -- the block added at
import -- and its entry deleted in the same change. The burn-down is tracked
by this list itself; it ends when `unprotected` is empty.
